d: Elizabeth sends crates of books from Michaela's deceased father's collection, prompting her to open a public library. Many become alarmed at the content of some of the books and want to prevent people from reading them.
Brian rescues a man from a trap who has horrific burns to his face from a train crash. Michaela decides to perform reconstructive surgery to repair his face.
With Monica's assistance, a man on death row seeks forgiveness.
At their 10th high school reunion, a wealthy businessman and a famous football star revisit their past.
Gloria follows a troubled teen to a rave party and ends up taking ecstasy.
An abandoned boy longs for the father he never knew and Gloria comes to his aid.
A former history professor is taught a life lesson at just the right moment.
The holiday season is not the same for a family dealing with the aftermath of Sept. 11, and the Angels lend their support.
Monica is reunited with her long-time friend, Elizabeth, a recovering alcoholic, who has a secret to share with Monica.
The Angels assist a man who must learn that he can't control every aspect of his life or the lives of others.
The Angels revisit an old friend hoping to help him realize his vision within the television industry.
The Angels assist a man who has not been able to share a painful secret with his family.
Andrew comes to the rescue of a marriage that is starting off on the wrong foot.
After her mother dies, 10-year-old Danni Blake is determined to find the father she never knew.

Cloud Dancing and the rest of the Cheyenne are told to move to a reservation where they would be dependent on handouts. Dr. Mike, Sully, and the children head to Washington to lodge a complaint and get the order changed.

Arriving in Washington, Dr. Mike and Sully find it difficult to find anyone to listen to their concerns. Sully is arrested for army desertion, while a plot against the president is overheard. Michaela must break Sully out of jail to expose the conspiracy.
When money becomes short for Sully, he tries everything to make ends meet rather than accept help from Dr. Mike.
